question: 已支付销售收入是多少？

question: 2026年9月已支付销售收入是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT coalesce(sum((SELECT sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM business.order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id)),0) AS value FROM business.orders o WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'

question: 华东地区已支付销售收入是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT coalesce(sum((SELECT sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM business.order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id)),0) AS value FROM business.orders o JOIN business.customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='paid' AND c.region='华东'

question: 各地区已支付销售收入比较
reference_sql: SELECT c.region AS dimension,coalesce(sum((SELECT sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM business.order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id)),0) AS value FROM business.orders o JOIN business.customers c ON c.id=o.customer_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY c.region ORDER BY dimension

question: 各商品类别销售收入比较
reference_sql: SELECT p.category AS dimension,sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS value FROM business.order_items i JOIN business.orders o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN business.products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY dimension

question: 销售收入最高的前5个商品
reference_sql: SELECT p.name AS dimension,sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) AS value FROM business.order_items i JOIN business.orders o ON o.id=i.order_id JOIN business.products p ON p.id=i.product_id WHERE o.status='paid' GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY value DESC,dimension LIMIT 5

question: 2026年9月退款订单率是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE coalesce((SELECT sum(r.refund_amount) FROM business.refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.id AND r.status='succeeded'),0)>0)::numeric/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS value FROM business.orders o WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'

question: 2026年9月成功退款金额是多少？

question: 2026年9月退款金额率是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT sum(coalesce((SELECT sum(r.refund_amount) FROM business.refunds r WHERE r.order_id=o.id AND r.status='succeeded'),0))/NULLIF(sum((SELECT sum(i.quantity*i.unit_price) FROM business.order_items i WHERE i.order_id=o.id)),0) AS value FROM business.orders o WHERE o.status='paid' AND o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-09-01 00:00:00+00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-10-01 00:00:00+00'
